item.title: Show HN: Lapse - a notes app. but also shared memory space for your agents (MCP)
item.summary: connects to wherever you're. Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Local LLM (ollama), or any MCP client. I use it via iPhone shortcut.
